title: ArcticDB `universe` library -- one symbol frame row (v1)
description: Column/dtype/index contract for the ArcticDB `universe` library (nousergon_lib.arcticdb.UNIVERSE_LIB), read read-only via load_universe_ohlcv/open_universe_lib -> _load_arctic_frames. One row per (symbol, trading day): a tz-naive DatetimeIndex date value plus the OHLCV_COLUMNS ('Open','High','Low','Close','Volume'). _load_arctic_frames normalizes to a monotonic DatetimeIndex, tz-stripped, duplicate index values collapsed keep=last. Bitemporal columns (settled, as_of, source_tier, valid_date, knowledge_time) are ADDITIVE (config#2459) -- absent on rows written before that change, present is never required. Consumer: crucible (v2 data.daily, first-class), crucible/crucible/data/sources.py::ArcticPriceSource.load_panel -> normalize_panel, which renames Open/High/Low/Close/Volume -> open_raw/high_raw/low_raw/close_raw/volume_raw (PANEL_COLUMNS) and raises MissingSourceError on any missing OHLCV column -- never zero-fills. v1 predictor/research until phase 4 (retiring). Plan §3 boundary table row 3.

index_date.description: The frame's DatetimeIndex value for this row, tz-naive, no intraday component after normalization.
